q1.sampleAnswer: My name is Li Ming. I’m thirteen years old. I live in Beijing, in China. I usually get up at half past six on school days, but at the weekend I get up at nine o’clock. I have lunch with my friends every day in the school canteen, because we’re in the same class. Last Sunday morning I went to the park near my home with my dad. We played badminton and then we walked around the lake. The weather was sunny and warm, and I took some photos of the flowers. I go shopping about once a month with my mum. I enjoy buying books and sometimes new trainers, because I love reading and running.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法与词汇：简单语法结构的掌握，日常话题词汇的运用
互动交流：回答切题，内容充分，能延展回答
整体表现：能用简单的语言完成交流任务

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答能直接回答每个问题，并多说一两句理由或细节（例如几点起床、和谁一起吃午饭、早上在户外做了什么、喜欢买什么），用一般现在时说习惯、用一般过去时讲经历，句子简单正确、前后连贯。

q2.sampleAnswer: I think getting to school by bus is a good idea, because it’s cheap and you can chat with your friends. But taking the train to school is expensive, and the station is far from my home. Travelling by car is comfortable, especially when it’s cold or rainy. Walking to school is fun, because you can talk with your friends and it’s good for you. I think going to school by scooter is a bit dangerous, because there are lots of cars on the road. I like walking best. I usually travel to school with my friends, because it’s more fun than going on my own. On a long, boring journey, I listen to music or read a book, because it makes the time go quickly.

q2.explanationZh: 好的回答会对图中的上学方式（坐公交车、坐火车、坐汽车、步行、骑滑板车）说出喜不喜欢以及原因，回应同伴的提问，回答考官的追问，说出最喜欢哪一种，并能谈自己平时一个人还是和朋友一起上学、长途旅行无聊时做什么，用 because、but 等把理由说清楚。
